description: Create the analytics property for a project via POST /api/v1/analytics/property and receive the site key for the tracking snippet. The siteKey field in the result is shown EXACTLY ONCE — install it immediately; it cannot be re-read (recovery: analytics_rotate_key mints a fresh one). 409 property_exists (with propertyId) if the project already has a property. Does not use credits.
name: analytics_create_property
title: Create analytics property
